speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope. The clinical presentation of syncope occurring immediately after urination in an older male, combined with a very brief loss of consciousness (30 seconds), immediate recovery without confusion, and negative workup for cardiac structural disease or ischemia, is diagnostic. The mechanism involves vasovagal stimulation and venous pooling upon standing after bladder emptying.
